title: John's x-equation
description: Essential: Must state the approximate equation of motion in the x-direction, e.g., a_x + ω²x = 0.

title: John's y-equation
description: Essential: Must state the approximate equation of motion in the y-direction, e.g., a_y + ω²y = 0.

title: Ella's x-coordinate
description: Essential: Must provide the correct expression for x̃(t), involving both ω and Ω, matching the transformation from the given initial conditions.

title: Ella's y-coordinate
description: Essential: Must provide the correct expression for ỹ(t), involving both ω and Ω, matching the transformation from the given initial conditions.

title: Paris period value
description: Essential: Must give the final numerical period for Paris, approximately 16 hours.

title: Rotation transformation application
description: Important: Must correctly apply the rotation transformation (x̃ = x cos(Ωt) + y sin(Ωt), etc.) to derive Ella's coordinates.

title: Initial condition substitution
description: Important: Must correctly substitute the inertial frame solutions x(t)=Acos(ωt) and y(t)=(V/ω)sin(ωt) into the rotation formulas.

title: Period formula derivation
description: Important: Must relate the general period T to the North Pole period (12 hours) and latitude, using T = 12/sin(θ) or equivalent.

title: Sign error in rotation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the signs in the rotation matrix (e.g., for ỹ) are incorrect.

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the final period lacks units or uses incorrect units (e.g., seconds instead of hours).
